tools.name: board_input_get_contacts
tools.description: Returns guidance on polling active physical contacts (fingers and glyphs) from the Board surface using BoardInput.GetActiveContacts().

contactTypes.description: Contact types to filter. Omit for all types.

tools.name: board_input_contact_lifecycle
tools.description: Explains the BoardContact phase state machine (Began → Moved/Stationary → Ended/Canceled) and provides a handler example.

tools.name: board_input_configure_settings
tools.description: Provides guidance on configuring BoardInputSettings including translation smoothing, rotation smoothing, and piece set model filename.

smoothing.description: Translation smoothing factor (0-1). Lower = less smoothing.

rotation.description: Rotation smoothing factor (0-1). Lower = less smoothing.

pieceSetFile.description: Filename of the piece set model for glyph recognition. Known sets: arcade, thrasos_arcade, chop_chop, mushka, chop_chop_mushka, omakase, save_the_bloogs.

tools.name: board_input_simulator_setup
tools.description: Provides instructions for setting up the Board Input simulator in the Unity Editor for testing without a physical Board device.

tools.name: board_input_glyph_setup
tools.description: Explains how to set up glyph (physical game piece) detection including piece set model configuration. Available piece sets: arcade, thrasos_arcade, chop_chop, mushka, chop_chop_mushka, omakase, save_the_bloogs.

pieceSetName.description: Name or model filename of the piece set to configure. Known sets: arcade, thrasos_arcade, chop_chop, mushka, chop_chop_mushka, omakase, save_the_bloogs.

tools.name: board_input_list_piece_sets
tools.description: Returns the catalog of available Board piece set models for physical game piece (glyph) recognition, including model filenames, versions, and associated games.

game.description: Filter by game name (e.g. 'Chop Chop', 'Mushka'). Omit for all piece sets.

tools.name: board_input_debug_view
tools.description: Explains how to enable the Board Input debug overlay for visualizing contact positions, glyph IDs, and bounds in development builds.

tools.name: board_session_get_players
tools.description: Returns guidance on accessing the current player roster via BoardSession.players and understanding the distinction from activeProfile.

tools.name: board_session_add_player
tools.description: Explains how to present the Board player selector UI to add an additional player to the session using PresentAddPlayerSelector().

tools.name: board_session_replace_player
tools.description: Explains how to replace an existing player in the session using PresentReplacePlayerSelector().

sessionId.description: The session index of the player to replace (0-based index into BoardSession.players).

tools.name: board_session_reset_players
tools.description: Explains when and how to use BoardSession.ResetPlayers() to restore the player roster to its initial state.

tools.name: board_session_player_types
tools.description: Explains the BoardPlayerType enum (Profile vs Guest) and when each type appears in the session.

tools.name: board_session_active_profile
tools.description: Explains the distinction between BoardSession.activeProfile and BoardSession.players, and when to use each.

tools.name: board_save_create
tools.description: Explains how to create a new cloud-backed save game with BoardSaveGameManager.CreateSaveGame(), including payload, description, and optional cover image.

payload.description: Description of the save game payload data format.

coverImage.description: Whether to include a cover image.

tools.name: board_save_update
tools.description: Explains how to update an existing save game's payload and metadata using BoardSaveGameManager.UpdateSaveGame().

saveId.description: The GUID string of the save game to update.

tools.name: board_save_load
tools.description: Explains how to load a save game with BoardSaveGameManager.LoadSaveGame(), including the critical player activation side-effect.

saveId.description: The GUID string of the save game to load.

tools.name: board_save_list
tools.description: Explains how to retrieve metadata for all save games using BoardSaveGameManager.GetSaveGamesMetadata().

tools.name: board_save_cover_image
tools.description: Explains how to load a save game's cover image as a Texture2D using BoardSaveGameManager.LoadSaveGameCoverImage().

saveId.description: The GUID string of the save game.

tools.name: board_save_storage_info
tools.description: Explains how to check storage limits and current usage with GetMaxPayloadSize(), GetMaxAppStorage(), and GetAppStorageInfo().

tools.name: board_save_remove_players
tools.description: Explains how to remove players from a save game using BoardSaveGameManager.RemovePlayersFromSaveGame(), including auto-delete behavior.

saveId.description: The GUID string of the save game.

tools.name: board_save_remove_profile
tools.description: Explains how to remove the active profile from a save game using BoardSaveGameManager.RemoveActiveProfileFromSaveGame().

saveId.description: The GUID string of the save game.

tools.name: board_app_pause_screen
tools.description: Explains how to configure the Board pause screen using SetPauseScreenContext() (full replace) vs UpdatePauseScreenContext() (partial merge).

context.description: Example pause screen context fields to include in the code example.

tools.name: board_app_profile_switcher
tools.description: Explains how to show or hide the Board profile switcher overlay button using ShowProfileSwitcher() / HideProfileSwitcher().

visible.description: Whether to show (true) or hide (false) the profile switcher.

tools.name: board_app_exit
tools.description: Explains how to cleanly exit the Board application using BoardApplication.Exit(), including platform behavior differences.

tools.name: board_app_pause_events
tools.description: Explains how to subscribe to Board pause screen events and handle them in your game.
